opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, my name is Ruud. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as required.

verification.comment: The caller gave an order number, but the agent never confirmed the caller's full name or postcode before sharing order details; the agent should have asked for the full name plus order number or postcode before reading out the order.

understanding.quote: Sorry. Unfortunately our we turn window is 14 days, so it's too late to return it.
understanding.comment: The agent cut the caller off mid-sentence and asked what they wanted, though the caller had already stated a return; the agent should have listened to the full request.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Unfortunately our we turn window is 14 days, so it's too late to return it.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery, not 14, so the caller at 20 days was eligible and was wrongly refused.

process_compliance.quote: I'll email you our returns policy today.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo step applied here, but the agent should have correctly processed the eligible return and emailed a free return label, since the item is EUR 59 and must go back.

communication.comment: The closing was brief and the company name was mispronounced; the agent should speak politely and clearly, and the caller showed mild disappointment that went unacknowledged.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else, but did not confirm what happens next correctly and ended with a mispronounced company name.
